svg.title: All electronics on one carrier · 18 × 24 holes — top worksheet
svg.text: 18 columns × 24 rows A–X · 2.54 mm pitch · nominal outline 47.78 × 63.02 mm · not a drilling template
INSERT THESE LEGS · role → hole / net
Db stripe = cathode K at V5.
Identify actual E/B/C and D/G/S legs before inserting. Drawn package faces do not
specify supplier pin order. Do not trim retained legs: their lengths and every
solder joint are on the bottom sheet.
Dashed rectangles are provisional module body zones, not header patterns. Use
insulating supports; verify USB access, antenna keepout and case clearance. Module
and external wire endpoints: modules sheet.
432 isolated pads · square = wire attachment · use all three carrier sheets
Isolated pads: only listed joints connect. OUT− is system ground; BAT− stays separate. Proposed layout; verify actual parts.
